sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body:
Kyparissi is a Greek sport climbing destination on the Peloponnese coast, with limestone walls, sea views, tufas and enough bolted climbing to justify a dedicated trip.

It is a quieter proposition than the biggest Greek climbing names. Come here for a coastal base, long limestone days, and the feeling of being in a village rather than a resort.

sections.heading: Rock and climbing character
sections.body: The climbing is sport climbing on limestone, with tufas and varied wall styles. The coastal setting is part of the character: this is not an inland training crag, but a village-and-sea destination where climbing days are shaped by aspect, heat and approach logistics.

sections.heading: Who it suits
sections.body: Kyparissi suits sport climbers who want a quieter Greek limestone base and are comfortable planning from current local information. It is not yet documented enough in this file for a beginner logistics page, but the scale supports more than a one-day stop.
